subject: Malik Willis and the new offense
current_answer: Willis is the clear projected starter. Designed rushing is already visible, while passing results have varied with protection and receiver execution.
next_test: Record preseason dropbacks, designed runs, play action, pressure response, and target distribution.

subject: De'Von Achane workload
current_answer: Achane is the clear RB1 and has independently corroborated involvement as a runner and receiver. The backfield split, route and target shares, and goal-line allocation are not established.
next_test: Chart preseason snaps, routes, designed targets, carries inside the 10, two-minute work, and Willis goal-line keepers.

subject: Receiver pecking order
current_answer: Malik Washington has the strongest current route-floor evidence through consistency, documented Willis chemistry, improved separation, and repeated downfield usage examples. Tolbert has the clearest X projection and added an August 6 back-shoulder catch; Atwell projects as the vertical Z; Douglas is the first healthy rookie challenger. Bell remains on active/NFI. Exact first-unit routes, two-receiver personnel, situational work, and target shares are unresolved.
next_test: Chart the first preseason game's routes, X/Z/slot alignments, two-receiver personnel, third-down and two-minute work, target type, blocking, and returns.

subject: Kadyn Proctor position and starting line
current_answer: Proctor has settled at left guard. The projected line is Patrick Paul, Proctor, Aaron Brewer, Jonah Savaiinaea, and Austin Jackson; Charlie Heck is the first documented replacement at right tackle while Jackson is day-to-day.
next_test: Confirm Jackson's return and chart Heck and the starting five against preseason pressures and line games.

subject: Chris Johnson immediate role
current_answer: Johnson is projected to start and is learning outside corner and nickel. His primary alignment, matchup assignments, and every-down share remain open.
next_test: Chart preseason outside/nickel snaps, coverage technique, and whether he stays on the field in base and subpackages.

subject: Edge rotation behind Chop Robinson
current_answer: Robinson is the clear lead edge. Uche has the best early evidence for the complementary pass-rush role, with Ferrell, Goode, Moore, Ojabo, and others still competing by situation. The stated defense will vary front and edge width by personnel and opponent.
next_test: Chart preseason early-down, third-down, and two-minute edge combinations plus pressures by alignment.

subject: Safety and nickel competitions
current_answer: Dante Trader projects at one safety spot. Lonnie Johnson remains a projected starter but is day-to-day; Zayne Anderson has two reported interceptions and is pressing the competition. Chris Johnson has the strongest confirmed nickel path; Duggan views Jason Marshall primarily outside, and Hafley may split early-down, big-nickel, and passing-down work. Mixed man and zone are confirmed intentions, not yet measured rates.
next_test: Chart preseason base/subpackage alignments, deep/box responsibility, slot snaps, outside pair when Chris Johnson moves inside, coverage family, and special-teams participation.

subject: Bobby Slowik personnel and play calling
current_answer: Slowik has confirmed a shared Shanahan-tree foundation, run-game emphasis, precision passing, and continued extensive motion. Camp has shown designed Willis keepers and multi-use tight ends, and the Franklin claim expanded the tight-end room to six. Personnel groupings, route releases, motion rate, pass rate, play-action frequency, and execution remain unresolved.
next_test: Chart the preseason opener by personnel, tight-end alignment and route release, motion, play action, launch point, early-down call, quarterback design, and operational error.

subject: Kicker competition
current_answer: Patterson and Gonzalez both converted the available reported situational kicks; no leader is established. Tabor's dedicated practice periods make unit placement and repetitions meaningful evidence.
next_test: Log every reported attempt by distance and hash plus kickoffs, operation consistency, and game-pressure opportunities.

subject: Thirteen-rookie roster influence
current_answer: Proctor and Chris Johnson project as immediate starters; Rodriguez, Douglas, Kacmarek, Moore, and others have relevant camp evidence. Bell remains on NFI and Konga is out for the season.
next_test: Record preseason snaps by phase, first-unit appearances, special-teams roles, health, and the first cutdown decisions.
